description: Madagascar - Distance to Current Grid is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy access", published or maintained by KTH Royal Institute of Technology in Stockholm. The dataset displays the distance in kilometers from the existing electricity grid in Madagascar. The dataset was developed by KTH-dESA, based on the Small Hydro GIS Atlas developed by ESMAP (2017) for existing grid data (. Coverage: Madagascar. It has 1 file in GeoTIFF. The portal files it under Energy access. The portal gives 2015 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
